name: Broken Bones
author: Skate3clone
description: Impact-based limb injuries using native contacts, joint topology and reversible constraint overrides. All damage rules run in Lua.

impact_impulse.label: Impact impulse threshold
impact_impulse.description: Gameplay threshold in N s; tune for your preferred injury frequency.

closing_speed.label: Minimum impact speed
closing_speed.description: Minimum pre-solve closing speed in metres/second; excludes resting support.

cooldown.label: Impact cooldown
cooldown.description: Seconds between counted impacts on the same joint.

only_bails.label: Only injure during bails
only_bails.description: Retain recent impacts briefly to catch the transition into a bail.

show_hud.label: Show injuries
show_hud.description: Display local and remote injury summaries.

heal_on_teleport.label: Heal on teleport
heal_on_teleport.description: Restore joints when a teleport/reset state is observed.
